mapper.select: SELECT FROM orders WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT FROM orders WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
SELECT FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT DISTINCT FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_addresses a ON o.id = a.order_id AND a.type = 'receiver' WHERE REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(IFNULL(a.contact_phone, '')), ' ', ''), '-', '') = #{normalizedPhone} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC
SELECT FROM orders WHERE courier_id = #{courierId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM orders WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM orders ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending' AND courier_id IS NULL ORDER BY create_time ASC
SELECT FROM orders WHERE is_exception = 1 OR `status` = 'exception' ORDER BY update_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders
AND (order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR IFNULL(goods_description, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders
SELECT `status` AS s, COUNT(*) AS c FROM orders GROUP BY `status`
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(actual_amount), 0) FROM orders WHERE `status` = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time < #{endTime}
SELECT DATE(create_time) AS `bucket` , COUNT(*) AS `cnt` FROM orders WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY `bucket`

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') AS `bucket` , COUNT(*) AS `cnt` FROM orders WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') ORDER BY `bucket`

SELECT DATE(update_time) AS `bucket` , COALESCE(SUM(actual_amount), 0) AS `revenue` FROM orders WHERE update_time >= #{startTime} AND update_time < #{endTime} AND `status` IN ('delivered', 'completed') GROUP BY DATE(update_time) ORDER BY `bucket`
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM orders WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time < #{endTime}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_no, user_id, goods_type_id, goods_description, goods_weight, status, order_type, total_amount, actual_amount, pay_type, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{goodsTypeId}, #{goodsDescription}, #{goodsWeight}, #{status}, #{orderType}, #{totalAmount}, #{actualAmount}, #{payType}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE orders SET actual_amount = #{actualAmount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
